Game Overview

In Jump in the Circle, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a frenetic arcade experience with Jump In The Circle. Leap tirelessly inside a moving ring, dodging unexpected spikes while gathering precious gems. As the pace intensifies, unlock vibrant skins and strive to surpass your personal best. Master the challenge and compete for glory with friends.
